title: Regional model sourcing playbook and vendor readiness index
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Create a repeatable playbook for sourcing and qualifying third-party model offerings across regions (APAC, EMEA, NA). Deliver a Vendor Readiness Index (VRI) that scores candidate models and vendors on production fit for Redwood Inference (performance, latency, pricing, compliance, deployment compatibility). The goal is to produce a prioritized shortlist and a set of tooling/benchmarks so PM, Partnerships, and Eng can accelerate onboarding decisions with objective signals.
acceptance_criteria: VRI rubric defined with weighted factors and scoring examples for 10 candidate models/vendors
Benchmarks run: latency p50/p95, cost-per-1M-tokens estimate, embedding throughput for sample workloads across 3 regions
Regional compliance checklist (data residency, acceptable licenses, export controls) for APAC and EMEA produced and validated with Legal
Shortlist of 6 candidate models with recommendation (Pilot / Watch / Reject) and rationale
Handoff artifacts: Confluence playbook, a reproducible benchmark notebook in GitHub, and a one-page exec memo
tasks: Draft VRI rubric and weights (PM + Research)
Identify 12 candidate models/vendors covering open and hosted variants
Run latency and throughput probes from test agents in us-east1, europe-west1, ap-southeast1
Estimate per-token cost using published pricing or probe runs; include quantized variant where available
Legal review for license/compliance edge cases for shortlisted vendors
Collect feedback from Solutions Engineering on integration effort and runtime compatibility
Produce Confluence playbook and attach benchmark scripts + raw results
Prepare executive 1-pager with recommended pilots and go/no-go criteria
notes: Focus on models that are realistic for Dedicated and Private customers (bring-your-own-model and hosted options).
We need automated probes that simulate common Redwood workloads: chat (context 2k), embeddings (batch 128), and reranking (top-k).
Quantized variants often reduce throughput variability but may change output fidelity—include small eval suite to detect regressions.
Regional constraints: several APAC customers require data residency in SG/Japan; flag vendors without regional endpoints.
Make VRI easy to extend: store raw scores in CSV from benchmark scripts so Partnerships can add new vendors later.
